attempts.text: {"inventedFacts":[{"span":"It seems the pirates have become rather conspicuous lately.","severity":"minor","reason":"implies a comparison with an earlier state and links Dunmore to the pirates as a cause; framed with 'it seems' but 'lately' asserts change"},{"span":"Conversely, Kael Dunmore now carries a price tag after an ambush near Gallowmere.","severity":"minor","reason":"'now' is forbidden and implies a before/after; 'conversely' wrongly frames the same fact as contrasting"},{"span":"One assumes the skirmish was rather spirited.","severity":"minor","reason":"framed as a guess, so acceptable; only the idea of a skirmish is implied, not stated"}],"voice":2,"clarity":2,"tone":3,"overall":2,"comment":"The two briefing items are really one fact, and the bulletin splits them into two items, so the second repeats the first with an illogical 'Conversely'.
